rounds.topic: State-Space Vector Representation for Vehicles — Deep Investigation Loop 21

rounds.finding: Empirical Round 22: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of non-linear state transition model (constant turn rate and acceleration - ctra). rounds.topic: State Prediction Step: Extrapolating Mean and Covariance — Deep Investigation Loop 23
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 23: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of state prediction step: extrapolating mean and covariance. Predicting state forward by time `dt`: `x_{k|k-1} = f(x_{k-1})`, with error covariance extrapolated as `P_{k|k-1} = F * P_{k-1} * F^T + Q`, where Q is the process noise covariance matrix. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.finding: Empirical Round 24: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of jacobian matrix computation for non-linear transitions. rounds.topic: Measurement Model: Mapping State to GPS Observations — Deep Investigation Loop 25
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 25: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of measurement model: mapping state to gps observations. rounds.topic: Kalman Gain Derivation & Optimal Weighting — Deep Investigation Loop 26
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 26: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of kalman gain derivation & optimal weighting. rounds.topic: Measurement Update Step: Correcting State and Covariance — Deep Investigation Loop 27
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 27: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of measurement update step: correcting state and covariance. Correcting the predicted state with incoming GPS measurements: `x_k = x_{k|k-1} + K * (z_k - h(x_{k|k-1}))`, updating covariance as `P_k = (I - K * H) * P_{k|k-1}`. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: Innovation Vector (Residual) & Outlier Rejection — Deep Investigation Loop 29
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 29: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of innovation vector (residual) & outlier rejection.
